areas.readOnly: You can see the areas but not change them.
areas.how: Tick a whole district, or open it to tick single upazilas. A ticked upazila is priced by this zone even when its district belongs to another zone. Turn on Remote to add this zone's remote surcharge for that area. A district that no zone lists is priced by the fallback zone.
areas.howFallback: This is the fallback zone: any district no zone lists is priced here, so you only need to list districts here that must be marked remote.

areas.upazilaHelp: Upazilas of {name}. A ticked upazila overrides its district.
areas.noUpazilas: No upazilas are listed for this district. You can add them with Add upazilas on the zones page.

rates.readOnly: You can see the rates but not change them.
rates.howItWorks: Charge = base fee + weight fee + remote surcharge. The weight fee is that of the first slab that holds the parcel; above the last slab it is that slab's fee plus the per-kilogram fee for every started kilogram. Reaching the free-delivery amount removes the base and weight fees, never the remote surcharge. Amounts are in taka (BDT).
rates.baseFeeHint: Charged on every order to this zone. Up to 2 decimals.
rates.remoteHint: Added for areas marked Remote. Enter 0 for none.
rates.freeHint: Leave empty for no free delivery. Orders at or above this value pay no base or weight fee.
rates.maxWeightHintIntl: International parcels can be at most 20 kg; leave empty for no limit here.
rates.slabsHelp: Each slab gives a weight limit and the fee added to the base fee for parcels up to that limit (and above the slab before it). Enter 0 for a slab that adds nothing.
rates.noSlabs: No weight slabs: the charge does not depend on weight.
rates.perExtraKg: Per extra kilogram above the last slab (BDT)
rates.perExtraKgHint: Added for every started kilogram above the last slab. Enter 0 for none.
rates.rangesHelp: Check the ranges below before saving.
rates.rangeBeyondFee: Last slab fee + {perKg} per started kg

errors.kgNotPositive: The weight must be above zero.

quote.unsaved: You have unsaved changes. The quote uses the saved rates and areas, so save first to check them.

quote.noAreasHint: This zone has no areas yet.
quote.upazilaHint: An upazila can be priced differently from its district.
quote.noCountriesHint: No switched-on country uses this zone yet (or you cannot see countries).

delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.description: This zone and its rates are removed for good. Its {areas, plural, one {# area} other {# areas}} are then priced by the fallback zone. Orders already placed keep the charge they were given.
delete.blockedFallback: This is the fallback zone and cannot be deleted. Make another zone the fallback first, or switch this one off.
delete.blockedCountries: Countries still use this zone ({codes}) so it cannot be deleted. Move them to another zone on the Countries tab first, or switch this zone off.
